calibration_sources: LongMemEval & LoCoMo Long-Horizon Multi-Session Agent Memory Benchmarks
MemGPT / Letta OS-Style Pinned In-Context Core Memory + Archival Tiering Architecture
Zep / Graphiti Bi-Temporal Knowledge Graph (t_valid, t_invalid Edge Invalidation vs Vector Stale-Fact Collision)

tiers.name: Tier 1: Full-History Context Stuffing (Prepending All 200K Past Chat Tokens Every Turn)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 1: 全量历史暴力塞入长窗口 (每轮拼接全部 200K 历史对话 Tokens)
tiers.memory_architecture: Raw 200,000-token transcript stuffed into context window; relies on LLM attention over noise

tiers.name: Tier 2: Rolling Recursive Summary Buffer (Compressing History into 1,500-Token Summary Every 10 Turns)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 2: 滚动递归摘要压缩 (每 10 轮将历史对话压缩为 1,500 词摘要)
tiers.memory_architecture: Fixed 1.5K-token summary overwritten recursively; drops fine-grained entities & timestamps

tiers.name: Tier 3: Flat Vector Episodic Memory (Embedding Past Conversation Turns into Milvus/pgvector Top-K)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 3: 扁平向量对话片段检索 (将历史对话切片存入向量库按相似度 Top-K 召回)
tiers.memory_architecture: Cosine similarity over past chat chunks; retrieves both stale & updated facts without validity timestamps

tiers.name: Tier 4: OS-Style Pinned Core Memory Block (Letta/MemGPT) + Bi-Temporal Knowledge Graph (Zep/Graphiti valid_from/invalid_at)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 4: 驻留核心记忆块 (Letta/MemGPT) + 双时态知识图谱 (Zep/Graphiti 有效期边替换)
tiers.memory_architecture: 2K Pinned Prefix-Cached Core State Block + Bi-Temporal Entity-Edge Graph (valid_from, invalid_at)
